description: This is a unit test class for the LoanCOBPartitioner, testing its partitioning logic for loan management in the context of batch processing.

classes.name: LoanCOBPartitionerTest
classes.description: Test class for LoanCOBPartitioner, verifying partitioning logic with different scenarios.

methods.name: testLoanCOBPartitioner
methods.description: Tests the partitioning functionality of LoanCOBPartitioner with mock data to confirm correct creation of partitions.

methods.name: testLoanCOBPartitionerEmptyBusinessSteps
methods.description: Ensures that when no business steps are available, the partitioner stops the job detector and returns no partitions.

methods.name: testLoanCOBPartitionerNoLoansFound
methods.description: Verifies behavior when no loan partitions are retrieved, expecting a single partition with zero range.
